description: This Python script sets up an audio processing pipeline for a conversational bot using Deepgram for speech-to-text, OpenAI for language modeling, and other custom services. It manages client connections, audio input/output, and orchestrates the flow of data through various stages including transcription, language modeling, and speech synthesis.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the conversational context for the language model, including the message history.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for aggregating user responses.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Orchestrates the sequence of processing steps in the audio pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a task with its pipeline and parameters, including idle timeout settings.

classes.name: LiveOptions
classes.description: Configuration for Deepgram's live speech processing options.

classes.name: DeepgramSTTService
classes.description: Service for real-time speech-to-text conversion using Deepgram.

classes.name: DeepgramTTSService
classes.description: Service for text-to-speech synthesis using Deepgram.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: Service to interact with OpenAI's language models.

classes.description: Abstract base class for transport mechanisms.

classes.description: Configuration parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

classes.description: Arguments passed to the runner, such as timeout settings and signal handling flags.

methods.description: Main entry point to initialize the transport and start the bot.
